title: SM ST4C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST4C 静态励磁系统，带自动电压调节器，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} 调节器比例增益、{Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} 调节器积分增益、{Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} 指定第一个超前-滞后环节的调节器滞后时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器输出上限、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器输出下限、{Forward proportional gain of inner loop field regulator, K_PM (pu)} 指定内环前向比例增益、{Forward integral gain of inner loop field regulator, K_IM (pu/s)} 指定内环前向积分增益、{Maximum output of field current regulator, V_Mmax (pu)} 指定励磁电流调节器输出上限、{Minimum output of field current regulator, V_Mmin (pu)} 指定励磁电流调节器输出下限、{Maximum exciter output, V_Amax (pu)} 指定励磁机输出上限、{Minimum exciter output, V_Amin (pu)} 指定励磁机输出下限、{Feedback gain of field current regulator, K_G (pu)} 指定励磁电流调节器的反馈增益、{Feedback time constant of field current regulator, T_G (s)} 指定励磁电流调节器的反馈时间常数、{Maximum feedback voltage for field current regulator, V_Gmax (pu)} 指定励磁电流调节器的最大反馈电压、{Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} 指定 PSS 输入位置 Summation point before take-over、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路电压增益系数、{Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)} 指定电势源电抗、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} 指定励磁机电压上限、{Power source selector} 指定电源选择器 Position A: power source derived from generator terminal，按实例取值。
